metrics.profile_summary: Digital marketing professional with over four years of experience specializing in social media, content creation, and website management. Strong background in visual design and instructional leadership in digital marketing and graphic design.

education.degree: Bachelor’s Degree in Islamic Studies with Computer Technology

experience.role: Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Web Designer and Graphic Designer
experience.description: Executed graphic design, whiteboard animations, and Meta marketing campaigns to increase brand visibility and business growth for various clients.
Teaches SEO, SEM, social media, and content strategy using Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, and WordPress.
Developed WordPress website, managed social media content, and led a design-focused team.
Taught advanced techniques in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and CorelDraw.
Led IT operations and mentored graphic designers while managing social media and organizational branding.

experience.role: Graphic Designer and Social Media Manager
experience.description: Created promotional visuals and monitored social media analytics to optimize outreach.

experience.role: Animator, Video Editor, and Graphic Designer
experience.description: Produced promotional materials, whiteboard animations, and managed agency social media platforms.
Enhanced visual branding through photo composition and editorial image editing.
Developed content strategies and produced high-quality animation videos and thumbnails.

strengths: Exceptional creative and visual content production skills
Broad knowledge of digital marketing tools (Meta, Google Ads, WordPress)
Experience in mentoring and leading small teams
weaknesses: Lacks required degree in Marketing or Business Administration
Insufficient total years of professional marketing management experience (5-7 years required)
No evidence of budget ownership or reporting on ROI/CAC/LTV
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly skilled digital content creator and specialist but lacks the strategic management experience, educational background, and financial accountability required for a Marketing Manager role.
